user_saw: After choosing a free-form slash command such as /steer, the composer gave no inline hint of what argument to type.
summary: Shows the command's free-form argument text (e.g. <message>) as a composer placeholder right after a slash command is selected, hidden once typing starts.
reasoning: The PR frames this as missing guidance, not broken behavior; it adds a new placeholder hint derived from existing command metadata. The pre-Solid Lit composer (removed lines in 07384e072380) only rendered cmd.args inside slash menu rows, which the Solid menu still does, so no prior inline hint was lost. This is a UX enhancement titled as a fix.
